name: Great Lakes Ace Hardware — Newport
limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. The branch and service pages establish curbside collection and delivery options, not physical access through the store. Parking-to-door routes, pickup-bay location, thresholds, door controls, aisle widths, toilets, quiet spaces and mobility equipment remain unverified. Bringing an order to the customer is not a promise of lifting, trunk loading, carrying goods indoors or personal assistance. Confirm product eligibility, fees and timing with the store.
facts: Newport’s branch page lists curbside pickup and home delivery among its store services. The branch phone is 859-360-2022.
STORE SERVICES Blade Sharpening Carpet Cleaning Curbside Pickup Glass Cutting Home & Auto Keys & FOB Duplication Home Delivery
For curbside pickup, select free store pickup when ordering online and wait for the email confirming the order is ready before traveling. Newport is included in the service’s location list.
ORDER - Order on acehardare.com and select FREE STORE PICKUP during checkout. DRIVE - Await email confirmation that your order is ready for pickup and drive to our local Great Lakes Ace.

On arrival for curbside pickup, call the store number in the confirmation email; the instructions say an associate will bring the order to you. They do not identify a collection bay or specify trunk loading.
CALL - Once you arrive, call the store phone number (found on your confirmation email) and a helpful associate will bring your order to you.

The home-delivery page includes Newport and says the product page indicates whether delivery or assembly is available from the selected store. It describes store-to-door delivery by an associate; no inside-the-home carrying service is established.
The product page will indicate if delivery or assembly are available from your store
DELIVER FROM STORE TO DOOR - Your order will be delivered by a helpful Great Lakes Associate.
